title: Create Aeronautics war
body:
Create Aeronautics War is a heavily mechanical, warfare-focused modpack built around the Create ecosystem and its most ambitious addons. Engineer sprawling automated factories on the ground, then take the fight to the skies aboard your own custom-built airships, submarines, and war machines.
🚀 Take to the Skies

At the heart of the pack sits Create: Aeronautics — build fully functional aircraft, arm them with Create: Big Cannons, and dog-fight across the skies. Launch artillery barrages, drop bombs from altitude, or board enemy vessels with throwable rope connectors. Radar systems let you track incoming threats before they find you.
🏭 Automate Everything

Powered by Create and a suite of addons — including Create: Addition, Diesel Generators, Liquid Fuel, and Enchantment Industry — your factory can grow from a simple assembly line into a continent-spanning industrial empire. Automate resource processing, fuel production, weapon manufacturing, and more.
⚔️ Modern Warfare

The pack integrates TACZ (Timeless and Classics Zero) with aeronautics compatibility, bringing modern firearms and weapons alongside your mechanical monstrosities. Pair conventional weapons with cannon-armed airships for devastating combined-arms combat.
🌊 Land, Air & Sea

Command the full battlefield with submarines (Create: Submarine), high-speed rail networks (Railways, Tracks+), and tank-class vehicles. No terrain is out of reach.
🗺️ Massive World

Explore a vast world enhanced by Distant Horizons for stunning far-plane rendering, Xaero's Minimap & World Map for navigation, and immersive visual upgrades via Sodium, Iris, and Entity Model Features.
🛠️ Quality of Life

Every builder's toolkit is covered: WorldEdit, KubeJS scripting, JEI/EMI recipe browsing, voice chat, Jade tooltips, and controller support via Controlify — so you can focus on the war, not the interface.
